It sucks to read reviews like this because they’re opposite of what Relay stands for: we enable small businesses to grow. ## What counts as a complaint at Relay?

A complaint is any expression of dissatisfaction about a Relay financial service, made orally or in writing, that alleges financial loss, distress, or inconvenience. That includes concerns about how your account was opened or closed, card issues, fees, rates, servicing, or customer service interactions.

## How do I file a complaint with Relay?

# How to File a Complaint With Relay

UpdatedAugust 11, 2026

You can file a formal complaint about any Relay service by emailing complaints@relayfi.com, and Relay acknowledges every complaint within one business day.

## What you need before you start

 Your name and the email address on your Relay account
 A clear description of what happened and when
 The outcome you are seeking (refund, correction, explanation, or other resolution)
 The complaint category that best fits your issue (see the list below)

## What counts as a complaint at Relay? [...] You did not receive an acknowledgment within one business day. Check your spam or junk folder for a message from Relay. If it is not there, resend your complaint or reach out to the Customer Experience team.
 You submitted a complaint but received a status update instead of a resolution. A holding response by day 15 is expected when an investigation needs more time. The final resolution follows by day 35.
 You are unsure whether your issue is a complaint or a dispute. A card dispute or ACH dispute is a distinct process for a specific transaction. See the related articles below for the right path.
